messages.text: Under 12¢ is a good rate to mine at. One heads-up though: the BS-4 is off sale while BitFortun fixes its firmware. Our pick right now is the Magic Miner 40T at $799 — best value per TH we sell. Is this your first miner?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Bitfortun BS-4 numbers for where you live.
